description: This is a startup shell script for configuring and launching the Parodus process, which involves fetching device properties, setting up environment variables, and executing the parodus binary with specific parameters.

methods.name: get_hardware_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware MAC address, either via getEstbMacAddressWithoutColon() or from /tmp/.macAddress file if the first method fails.

methods.name: get_ImageName
methods.description: Extracts the image name from /version.txt based on a specific version tag.

methods.name: parodus_start_up
methods.description: Main startup function for preparing device info and launching the parodus process with appropriate arguments.
